reader_summary: This section explains why understanding a place name and copying exactly the characters in an image are different goals. OCR recognizes image text; exact matching rejects any extra, missing or changed character, while CER gives the minimum number of insertions, deletions or substitutions divided by the reference length. In 今天去臺北 versus 今天去台北, only 台/臺 differs, so the result is false, one edit, five reference characters and CER 0.2. The comparison policy must decide normalization rules beforehand and preserve raw text. Empty images, unreadable visible text, synthetic documents, real signs, short lines and full pages require distinct evaluation cases or stated scope. The exercise omits 北: the reference remains five characters and CER is still 1/5.
